owner_and_capability: People Directory — the retained person and student services leave services/users (slice 4 of #2728, #3753). The person service is the concrete PersonDirectory in modules/peopledirectory/compose, without an interface: consumers keep the ports they own (#3771) and the root passes the concrete type. The change-history retention sweep is a People Directory compose service over consumer-owned ports. The photo, audit-actor and student-directory contracts and the student directory service move to the same compose package. The staff write inputs move with the embedded StaffDirectory port, so the owner of the two staff writes stays undecided.
atomic_cutover: One code-only change. person_directory_service.go, its ports and the two caregiver lookups move to modules/peopledirectory/compose as PersonDirectory with the StudentRoutePersons and GroupRoutePeople adapters; student_change_log_cleanup_service.go becomes a compose service over StudentChangeLogStore, StudentChangeLogDeletionLog and StudentChangeLogRetention, bound by services.NewStudentChangeLogCleanup with the same deletion-trail rows; student_photo_port.go, student_audit_port.go, student_directory_port.go and student_directory_service.go move to modules/peopledirectory/compose; the audit contract drops GetChangeHistory (only suites called it; they read the repository seam) and ErrPhotoNoTenant moves to its producer in services. The person and student suites stay in services/users because every other test scope would add keys. The error aliases of #3750 are removed: callers name userscontract, ErrPersonNotFound and ErrStudentNotFound move into userscontract with their instances, and the three staff write refusals move into services. The dead List and FindByName person reads and the unused companion re-exports are deleted. The Care Plan participation resolver is injected at construction (late-bound in the root, WithCareParticipation for test graphs), so no setter is added. services/users/userstest is deleted; its one consumer uses test.StaffAccountPeople. Routes, error bodies and /api/iot error texts are unchanged.
tests: services/users: the person behavior suite against the isolated PostgreSQL test database through the services factory, with exact wire messages where the external test scope may not import userscontract; the student deletion, consent, audit, photo, change-log cleanup, staff and offboarding suites.
modules/peopledirectory/compose: the roster enrollment rule and the fail-closed cleanup paths; modules/peopledirectory/userscontract: the error vocabulary.
Module suites that built the person service (Care Plan contract tests, communication messages, presence, parent portal, timetable) through services.NewTestPersonDirectory and test.StaffAccountPeople.
go test ./test (ratchets incl. function length, policy temporary rules, composition inventory), golangci-lint on the affected packages, scripts/test-changed.sh against the base without --fast.
